svg.text: Video: decode / encode on the B580 (VideoToolbox, mediakit)
source mediakit out_mac/results_mac.txt, macOS run 2026-10-30 21:08..16:27 · Windows reference: yes
target: decode bit-exact and >= Windows speed; encode BD-rate <= 0 vs Intel QSV at the same bitrate, overshoot <= 5%
works on macOS; Windows/QSV reference pending
not supported by the hardware (Intel media-driver Xe2 caps)
decode fps: per clip (30p / 60p clip at 1080p), graded against the fastest Windows path (D3D11VA); overshoot = bytes*8/duration/target - 1, max over all VBR streams
BD = worst BD-rate (PSNR-Y) of our VideoToolbox encoder vs Intel QSV at the same settings over the test contents; > 0 means more bits for the same quality
